questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (e.g., around 00:09), there are clearly three pens arranged in a row.
The rightmost pen is tilted diagonally (pointing down-right), while the left and middle pens are vertical (pointing straight down). They are not all aligned in the same direction.
All three pens appear to have black caps and translucent/dark grey barrels. While the right pen looks slightly darker due to angle/lighting, they are likely the same model.
All three pens have a thick black cap at the bottom end. No bare writing tips are exposed.
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without visible stopping or jamming.
The pens maintain their relative positions and orientations on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The rightmost pen is oriented diagonally while the other two are vertical. This violates the nominal condition that all three pens must point in the same direction (be aligned identically).

description: One pen is flipped relative to the others (variant).
